A small line of the last year of closes

Source: R/fct_markets.R
sparkline_svg.Rd

An inline SVG for a table cell: the closes of the last 365 days, thinned to at most 100 points, green when the year ended higher than it started and red when lower.

Usage

sparkline_svg(date, close, label, width = 110, height = 26)

Arguments

date

Dates of the closes, sorted.

close

The closes.

label

Name of the index, for screen readers.

width, height

Size in pixels.

Value

The SVG as a character string.

Examples

golemstockindices:::sparkline_svg(Sys.Date() - 300:0, cumsum(rnorm(301)) + 100, "Alpha")
